description: Defines the AppDatabase class for Room persistence library in Kotlin, serving as the main database class with DAO accessors for entities like Profile, Connection, and TransferHistory. Implements singleton pattern for database instance management.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class extending RoomDatabase, provides DAOs for accessing ProfileEntity, ConnectionEntity, TransferHistoryEntity, and manages singleton instantiation.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Abstract getter method providing access to ProfileDao operations.

methods.name: connectionDao
methods.description: Abstract getter method providing access to ConnectionDao operations.

methods.name: transferHistoryDao
methods.description: Abstract getter method providing access to TransferHistoryDao operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern method returning the AppDatabase instance, creating it if necessary, configured with the database name 'quick_transfer.db'.
